runtime.title: Blender runtime
runtime.notInstalled: Blender runtime is not installed. A one-time download (about 360 MB) is needed before rendering.

job.name: Job name
job.label: Label image (PNG, optional)
job.attention: This job failed repeatedly and was set aside so it does not block the queue. Check the error, then press Retry.

errors.PLATFORM_UNSUPPORTED: This OS/architecture is not supported yet.
errors.NETWORK: Network error while downloading. Check your connection and retry.
errors.HTTP_STATUS: The download server returned an error.
errors.CHECKSUM_MISMATCH: Downloaded file is corrupted (checksum mismatch). It was deleted and will be downloaded again.
errors.SIZE_MISMATCH: Downloaded file has the wrong size.
errors.DISK_SPACE: Not enough disk space to install Blender.
errors.SMOKE_TEST_FAILED: Blender does not run on this machine; the previous version (if any) was kept.
errors.MANIFEST_NO_TRUSTED_KEY: This build has no key to verify downloaded components, so none can be installed. Contact whoever gave you the trial build.
errors.MANIFEST_UNTRUSTED_KEY: The component catalogue does not come from a trusted source and was rejected.
errors.PACK_INVALID: The offline install file is invalid or damaged. Download it again and retry.
errors.PHOTO_HEIC_FAILED: This HEIC photo could not be converted to JPG (the file may be damaged). Pick another photo, or convert it to JPG on your phone and pick it again.
errors.PHOTO_TOO_LARGE: The photo is too large (over 120 MB). Pick a smaller one.
errors.DRAFT_TOO_LARGE: The draft is too large to save.
errors.ACTIVATE_FAILED: Could not activate the new runtime.
errors.INVALID_TIMELINE: Invalid timeline; cannot compile the render job.
errors.FFMPEG_FAILED: ffmpeg failed to encode the video.
errors.FFMPEG_MISSING: The video component is not ready. Install it (one-time) and try again.
errors.TARGET_UNSUPPORTED: Only running on this machine is supported in this version.
errors.INTERRUPTED: The app was closed while rendering.
errors.TEMPLATE_INPUT_INVALID: Some details are missing or incorrect. Check the red messages and fix them.
errors.TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND: This video template was not found. Please choose another one.
errors.LOGO_FORMAT: The logo must be a PNG, JPG or WEBP image (up to 20 MB). Please choose another file.
errors.OUTPUT_MISSING: There is no video to save yet. Create the video first.
errors.SLIDESHOW_PHOTO_MISSING: One of the photos could not be found. It may have been deleted or moved; please choose it again.
errors.SLIDESHOW_LOGO_MISSING: The logo file was not found. Choose the logo again or remove it.
errors.SLIDESHOW_AUDIO_MISSING: The music file was not found. Choose it again or select "no music".
errors.SLIDESHOW_FONT_MISSING: The app font was not found. Please reinstall the app.
errors.SLIDESHOW_FFMPEG_FAILED: The video could not be built. Try again; if it still fails, use a different photo (some photos are damaged or in an unusual format).
errors.SLIDESHOW_TOO_COMPLEX: The video has too many scenes or too much text. Remove some scenes or shorten the text.
errors.SLIDESHOW_BAD_PATH: A file path has characters that cannot be used. Rename the file or folder and choose it again.
errors.FFMPEG_LICENSE_VIOLATION: The video component is not ready. Open Settings to install or update it.
errors.FFMPEG_NO_ALLOWED_ENCODER: The video component is not ready. Open Settings to install or update it.
errors.DISK_FULL: The disk is full. Delete some files and try again.
